in_vitro_detail: Factor Xa enzymatic digestion of RMP16 in PBS with or without purified HSA at 37 degrees C with HPLC-ESI-MS quantitation (cell-free enzyme assay); SPR (BIAcore 3000) and ITC binding assays against purified HSA, MSA, hTNFRI and hTNFRII; proliferation assays in Du145, Raji, K562, Eca109, HeLa, MCF-7, MDA-MB-231, HUVEC and MCF10A cells; [125I]TNF alpha competition binding on ML-la cells; phage display screening and ELISA against coated HSA/MSA. A chick chorioallantoic membrane angiogenesis model was also used.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: In vitro ensymolysis half-life of RMP16 binding with or without HSA by Factor Xa.
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 2A is an in vitro time course of RMP16 remaining during Factor Xa digestion with or without HSA (samples at 0, 12, 24, 36 and 48 h, quantified by HPLC-ESI-MS), i.e. a stability/%-remaining versus time plot, not an in vivo plasma concentration-time curve. No in vivo plasma concentration-time figure is presented; the in vivo PK is given only as fitted parameters in Table 2.

bioanalytical_method: LC/MS/MS with electrospray ionization; standard curves prepared in citrated mouse plasma (2000 to 4 nM) with TCEP added to enhance peptide recovery; acetonitrile protein precipitation
bioanalytical_quote: the plasma portion was analyzed by using an electrospray ionization, LC/MS/MS method described previously
notes: PK parameters come from Table 2 for all three agents at 5 mg/kg IV. The Table 2 'Units' column gives 'h' for t1/2 and the Methods explicitly name the fitted parameter 'elimination half-life (t1/2)' from a two-compartment elimination model in WinNonlin, so these are half-lives in hours, not rate constants, and half_life_phase is 'elimination'. Dosing was intravenous, so no absorption phase exists or is reported. Results text and Table 2 agree (0.096 h = 5.76 min; 0.56 h = 33.6 min). A separate in vitro Factor Xa digestion half-life for RMP16 is also reported - 'the factor Xa enzyme digestion half-life of RMP16 was significantly prolonged to 15.83 h from 9.72 h' in the presence of HSA - but this is a cell-free enzymatic stability value, not a plasma half-life, and is deliberately not placed in any agent half_life field. Cmax and tmax are not reported for any agent. The PK cohort strain is given only as 'BALB/c mice'; the tumour study used BALB/c-nu/nu nude mice. TNF alpha half-life figures quoted in the INTRO and DISCUSSION (15-30 min, ~30 min) are literature statements, not this study's measurements, so the Table 2 value is used. Role 'other' is not used here; H398 is recorded as a comparator because it is a pharmacological blocking agent tested alongside RMP16.
